description: This Java class 'VerifyPickSessionRow' models a row of pick session verification data within the shipment verification process of the OFBiz framework. It manages information related to order, product, shipment, and inventory details and provides methods for issuing items to shipments and updating picklist items.

classes.name: VerifyPickSessionRow
classes.description: Represents a row in a shipment pick verification session, encapsulating order, shipment, product, and inventory data and providing methods to process item issuance.

methods.name: getOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the order item sequence ID.

methods.name: getShipGroupSeqId
methods.description: Returns the shipment group sequence ID.

methods.name: getReadyToVerifyQty
methods.description: Returns the quantity ready to be verified.

methods.name: setReadyToVerifyQty
methods.description: Sets the quantity ready to be verified.

methods.name: setShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets the shipment item sequence ID after issuance.

methods.name: getShipmentItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the shipment item sequence ID.

methods.name: setInvoiceItemSeqId
methods.description: Sets the invoice item sequence ID.

methods.name: getInvoiceItemSeqId
methods.description: Returns the invoice item sequence ID.

methods.name: getOrderItem
methods.description: Returns the associated order item generic value.

methods.name: isSameItem
methods.description: Checks if another row represents the same item based on inventory, order, and shipment group IDs.

methods.name: issueItemToShipment
methods.description: Issues inventory items to a shipment, updates picklist item status, and handles potential errors.
